topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: When I stumbled upon the stump where my childhood tree once stood, a swell of memories rushed back. It wasn’t just any tree; it was the one I planted with my father years ago, a small sapling that we nurtured together. Over the years, it grew alongside me, a silent witness to countless moments of laughter and contemplation. Even now, I can see the marks where I drew my name in the bark, marking the years as they passed. The tree is gone, but the legacy remains. Its memory is etched in the ground and in my heart, a testament to the care and love that went into every watering, every pruning. Life moves on, and so will I, carrying forward the lessons and joy it brought.
